'''2001 Massachusetts State Championship Hayes Hunter Hayes' Hidden Mains''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Hayes Hunter]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2001 Massachusetts State Championship]].<ref name="dt-15364">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15364 Hayes' Hidden Mains], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 17 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15364/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15364/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2001 Massachusetts State Championship]]
* '''Finish:''' 1st
* '''Published:''' 17 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Hayes' Hidden Mains''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 HB Hunter LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' My version of the best light deck currently available; it puts you in an excellent position to beat anything out there.

== Original post ==

'''Hayes' Hidden Mains'''
* '''Author:''' Hayes "Hayes" Hunter
* '''Published:''' April 17, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' My version of the best light deck currently available; it puts you in an excellent position to beat anything out there.

=== Strategy ===

Card for card what I won Massachusetts states with (see the TR)...  It's packed for destiny (hence O+B over Tawss or Orri, and the old skool SATM, etc.)... I'm pulling a Yannick, sue me.
